### What Is Systeme.io?

Systeme.io (pronounced “system-e-o”) is an all-in-one marketing platform launched in 2017 by French entrepreneur Aurélien Amacker. It bundles sales funnels, email marketing, online courses, a blog, a built-in affiliate program, automations, and a simple store into one tool — with a free plan that genuinely never expires. Bootstrapped and profitable, it now powers 500,000+ entrepreneurs. Long known as the budget ClickFunnels alternative, in 2025–2026 it added unlimited sub-accounts, white-labeling, a public API, and an MCP server — pushing it into GoHighLevel's agency territory at a fraction of the price.

### Key Features

### Genuinely Free Plan

2,000 contacts, 3 funnels, 1 course, 1 blog, a custom domain, unlimited emails and students — forever, with no credit card. The most generous free tier in the category.

### Sub-Accounts & White Label

Unlimited isolated client workspaces plus full white-labeling — your domain, logo, colors, and branded dashboard with zero Systeme.io branding. Included on the $97 Unlimited plan.

### Public API + MCP

A documented REST API with webhooks for contacts, tags, courses, funnels, and pages — plus an official MCP server so ChatGPT and Claude can work with your account directly.

### Built-In Affiliate Program

Run your own affiliate program on every tier — including the free plan. Systeme's own program pays 60% lifetime recurring, one of the most generous in the industry.

### Courses & Communities

Host unlimited students, build online courses with drip content, and run communities — all bundled in, with no separate course-platform subscription needed.

### Funnels, Email & Automation

Drag-and-drop funnels, unlimited email sends, evergreen webinars (Webinar plan), and visual automation rules. Functional and beginner-friendly, though templates are less polished than ClickFunnels.

### Systeme.io Is a True All-in-One

Beyond how it stacks up to ClickFunnels and GoHighLevel, Systeme.io is a complete business stack in one login — it replaces a dozen separate subscriptions. Here's the full toolkit, most of it available even on the free plan.

### Sales Funnels

Drag-and-drop funnel builder with A/B testing, 1-click upsells, order bumps, and countdown/deadline timers — the ClickFunnels core, included free.

### Websites & Blogs

Build full multi-page websites and a built-in blog on your own custom domain — a content stack that replaces WordPress or Wix.

### Email & Automation

Unlimited email sends plus a genuinely capable visual workflow builder — triggers, if/then conditional branching, timed delays, and multi-step sequences across email, SMS, tags, and course access. Unlimited workflows on every plan. A real alternative to Mailchimp or ActiveCampaign.

### CRM & Pipelines

A real Kanban CRM with custom deal stages, tags, and segmentation to move every lead from new to won — a built-in alternative to HubSpot or Pipedrive.

### SMS Marketing

Send outbound text automations to contacts from inside your workflows via a built-in Twilio integration (you supply your own Twilio account).

### Courses & Communities

Host unlimited students with drip content and progress tracking, plus free or paid member communities — replacing Teachable, Circle, or Skool.

### Booking Calendar

A Calendly-style scheduler built right in — clients pick a slot, get automated confirmations, and you can collect deposits or full payment up front.

### Affiliate Center

Run your own affiliate program for any product: set commission rates, generate links, track referrals in real time, and manage payouts — on every plan, including free.

### Store, Products & Coupons

Sell physical products with variants, inventory, and shipping, run a Linktree-style creator store, and issue coupon codes — no Shopify needed.

Also included: evergreen webinars, deadline funnels, multiple payment gateways with **no transaction fees**, plus the agency tooling above — [sub-accounts and white-label](https://funnelgoodies.com/gohighlevel-vs-systeme) — and a free done-for-you migration from your current platform.

## The Free Plan Is the Real Story

No other major all-in-one gives you this much for $0. ClickFunnels has no free plan; GoHighLevel offers only a 14-day trial. Systeme.io's free tier never expires and needs no card:

3 Funnels + a Course

### Pros & Cons

### Pros

- The most generous free plan in the category — no card, never expires
- Startup at $17/mo undercuts nearly every all-in-one platform
- White-label + unlimited sub-accounts at $97 (vs GoHighLevel's $497)
- Public REST API, webhooks, and an official MCP server for AI assistants
- 60% lifetime recurring affiliate program — one of the best anywhere
- Genuinely simple — far gentler learning curve than GoHighLevel

### Cons

- Funnel and page templates feel less polished than ClickFunnels
- Shallower CRM and automation depth than GoHighLevel
- SMS is outbound-only via a Twilio integration; no phone system or AI voice
- API is solid for contacts/tags/webhooks but not a deep platform API
- White-label requires the $97 Unlimited tier (not the cheaper plans)
- Smaller ecosystem, template marketplace, and brand recognition

**Bottom line:** Systeme.io wins decisively on price and simplicity, and its new white-label, API, and MCP features make it a credible budget agency platform. If you want the deepest agency/CRM stack, [GoHighLevel](https://funnelgoodies.com/gohighlevel-review) still leads; if you want the most polished funnels and the strongest training, [ClickFunnels](https://funnelgoodies.com/) does. For everyone watching their budget, Systeme.io is the value pick of the three.

### Who Is Systeme.io Best For?

### Budget Creators & Beginners

The free plan lets you launch a funnel, an email list, and a course for $0. The cheapest credible on-ramp into all-in-one marketing — no card, no trial clock.

### Course Creators & Coaches

Unlimited students, built-in courses and communities, email, and an affiliate program in one tool — no need to stack a separate course platform on top.

### Lean Agencies & Resellers

White-label and unlimited sub-accounts on the $97 Unlimited plan — a fraction of GoHighLevel's $497 SaaS Mode. Ideal for agencies that want resale without the price tag.

### Developers & Automators

The public REST API, webhooks, and MCP server let you wire Systeme.io into custom tools and AI assistants — unusual for a platform at this price.

 Editorial Take

## Why Systeme.io Is Suddenly a Three-Way Race

How the budget underdog quietly grew into a genuine third contender.

For years, the honest take on Systeme.io was simple: a great free plan and a cheap way to launch your first funnel, but not in the same conversation as [ClickFunnels](https://funnelgoodies.com/) or [GoHighLevel](https://funnelgoodies.com/gohighlevel-review). You used it to start, then graduated to something more powerful. We are revising that take.

In 2025–2026, Systeme.io shipped the features that used to define the gap. Unlimited sub-accounts and full white-labeling — the heart of GoHighLevel's agency moat — now arrive on the $97 Unlimited plan with no per-account fee, against GHL's $497 SaaS Mode. A public REST API with webhooks landed for developers, and then an official MCP server so ChatGPT and Claude can operate an account directly. That last one matters: most platforms at this price have no API at all, let alone an AI-native interface.

Let's keep it honest, though. Systeme.io is still the smallest of the three — roughly 500,000 signups and bootstrapped, not the venture-scaled machines CF and GHL have become. It is shallower than GoHighLevel on CRM automation, AI, and native phone/SMS (Systeme's texting is outbound-only through a Twilio integration, with no phone system), and its funnel templates do not match ClickFunnels for polish. Nobody should pretend it out-features either incumbent.

But it no longer needs to. The pitch has changed from “cheap starter tool” to “most of what you need, at a fraction of the price, with a real free tier.” For budget-conscious creators and lean agencies — the majority of this site's readers — that makes Systeme.io the third name that belongs in every funnel-software decision. This is a three-dog race now.

 Common Questions

## Frequently Asked Questions

How much does Systeme.io cost in 2026?

Systeme.io has four tiers: **Free at $0/month**, **Startup at $17/month**, **Webinar at $47/month**, and **Unlimited at $97/month**. Annual billing gives you two months free (roughly 17% off). The Free plan never expires and needs no credit card.

Is Systeme.io really free?

Yes. The Free plan is genuinely free forever with no credit card required. It includes up to **2,000 contacts, 3 sales funnels, 1 online course, 1 blog, 1 custom domain, unlimited emails and students**, and a built-in affiliate program. It is the most generous free tier among all-in-one platforms — [ClickFunnels](https://funnelgoodies.com/) has no free plan and [GoHighLevel](https://funnelgoodies.com/gohighlevel-review) offers only a 14-day trial.

Does Systeme.io have white label and sub-accounts?

Yes. Systeme.io offers unlimited sub-accounts (isolated client workspaces) and full white-labeling — your domain, logo, colors, sender email, branded dashboard, login, and system emails with zero Systeme.io branding. White-label is included on the **Unlimited plan at $97/month** with no per-account fee, which significantly undercuts GoHighLevel's SaaS Mode at $497/month. See our [GHL vs Systeme.io comparison](https://funnelgoodies.com/gohighlevel-vs-systeme) for the full agency breakdown.

Does Systeme.io have an API?

Yes. Systeme.io has a public REST API (OpenAPI-documented) covering contacts, tags, courses and enrollments, funnels and steps, newsletters, pages, subscriptions, and webhooks. You authenticate with an API key generated in your dashboard settings. It is solid for contact, tag, and automation workflows, though narrower than a deep platform API.

Does Systeme.io support MCP for AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude?

Yes. Systeme.io ships an official **MCP (Model Context Protocol) server** that lets AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude work with your contacts, tags, newsletters, and funnels. You generate an MCP key in Settings (up to two keys, each valid for 90 days). It is an early release with setup guides for both ChatGPT and Claude — and unusual for any platform at this price.

Is Systeme.io better than ClickFunnels?

For price and simplicity, yes — Systeme.io has a genuinely free plan, a $17 entry tier, and bundles email, courses, a blog, and affiliate-program management at no extra cost. ClickFunnels has no free plan and starts at $97/month. ClickFunnels wins on funnel-template polish, editor depth, brand cachet, and training like the [One Funnel Away Challenge](https://funnelgoodies.com/ofa-review). For most budget-conscious creators, Systeme.io is the better value. See the full [CF vs Systeme.io comparison](https://funnelgoodies.com/clickfunnels-vs-systeme).

Is Systeme.io better than GoHighLevel?

It depends on depth. Both now have a visual CRM with pipelines, white-label, and sub-accounts, and Systeme.io is far cheaper and simpler — white-label at $97 versus GoHighLevel's $497 SaaS Mode. But GoHighLevel is much deeper for agencies: native two-way SMS, a full phone system, AI voice agents, reputation management, deeper automation, and a bigger app ecosystem. Systeme.io's SMS is outbound-only via a Twilio integration. Choose Systeme.io for lean budget agencies and creators; choose GoHighLevel when you need a full agency operating system.

What is the Systeme.io affiliate program?

Systeme.io pays **60% lifetime recurring commission** — you earn every month a referral stays subscribed, with lifetime attribution rather than a short cookie window. Payouts are monthly via PayPal or wire with a $30 minimum. It is one of the most generous affiliate programs in the funnel-software category.
